author: Wickedzzx
quote: What a genuine disappointment. Theres a lot to like here in terms of gameplay potential and environment design. The story? Absolutely abysmal. Rockstar took their exisiting humour + dialogue and replaced it with such soulless, safe, and flat out cringe nonsense. Lucia an obnoxious, pretentious character who while acting like a complete nuisance to everyone, somehow she still recieves 0 pushback from any supporting characters. Jason? He exists simply to be the floor that Lucia walks on. His existence is dedicated to a woman who persistently treats him terribly yet every single character acts as if he should be doing more for her. The grounded yet hilarious character writing that the previous titles had is gone. It’s replaced with writing that has you wanting to rip your hair out whenever reaching a cutscene. This game was most enjoyable when Lucia was in jail. Nobody wants to play GTA sims. Screw this relationship simulator bs.
